summary: Narrow north kerb with houses 7-9 m away and a no-stopping sign.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a large building sit on the north side near the start; bush above, but dwellings are within 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs hard against a bank and retaining walls; no verge or pull-in beyond the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a painted centre line; one moving car seen, no parked cars on this side.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign mapped; cars park on the opposite side only.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation about 8.6 m, Witton Creek 37 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the eastern end; buildings and bush shade the north side.
